messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "talk with your doctor if increased need for medication in 24-hour period"
set: ["talk with your doctor if increased need for medication in 24-hour period", "talk to your doctor before dose is increased", "talk with your doctor about this risk", "talk to your doctor if pain increases", "talk to your doctor if this occurs", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "always talk to your doctor before stopping or switching medication", "talk with doctor about benefits of breastfeeding and treatment need", "talk to your doctor if you develop symptoms", "talk with your healthcare provider about the benefits of breastfeeding alongside your need for this medicine", "talk with your doctor about ways to keep your bones healthy", "talk with doctor about protecting bones", "if you stop for several days, talk to your doctor before starting again", "ask your doctor or pharmacist if you need help", "take with food if the medication upsets your stomach", "talk to your doctor before changing timing"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
